name: notify-switch
title: A toast on every instruction, documented nowhere and impossible to turn off
description: Measured: .pi/extensions/notify.ts ships in the release, is auto-discovered by Pi in every session, fires a Windows toast on every settled instruction, has no switch of any kind, and appears in no specification and no line of the README. The env-var off idiom already exists in this repository, so the switch follows it and defaults to on
creator: aixi
